Run every non-structural quality check against an already-loaded cache, without aborting

Source: R/0_data_quality_checks.R
run_all_quality_checks.Rd

Counterpart to run_quality_checks() above (which collects several checks and aborts once if any fail – the shape new_countdown()'s Tier B and merge_and_standardize()'s Tier A both need at load time). This one never aborts: it runs every non-structural check and returns a full report, for a caller that wants to show every result – pass or fail – rather than stop at the first problem. Built for the Load Data wizard's Data Quality step (apps/rmncah).

Usage

run_all_quality_checks(cache)

Arguments

cache

A CacheConnection (or anything exposing $wizard_parts, $countdown_data, $check_survey_admin_names(), $check_shapefile_admin_names() the same way).

Value

A named list, one entry per check: list(ok, severity, detail). severity is one of "blocking" (these gate progression past the Data Quality step), "informational" (shown, never block), or "mapping" (survey/shapefile admin-name matches – shown, never block, point instead at the relevant mapping step).

Details

Branches on whether cache still holds unmerged wizard parts (cache$wizard_parts, set by load_excel_parts() + CacheConnection$set_wizard_parts() – the normal case for a fresh Excel/Stata upload going through the wizard, Phase 3 of the Load Data wizard redesign) or already has merged countdown_data (a resumed .rds, edit mode, or any non-wizard caller) – the pre-merge branch runs the sheet-scoped checks above, attributing problems to the specific sheet they came from; the post-merge branch is the original, unchanged set of checks against the fully merged data.
